items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: when we organized the first band, which was all school kids, and we had a kid named Sid Bryant, who played the piano and Laird Craven on the Trombone

ctx.x: Well, anyway, when it came time to join the Boy Scouts, I think I joined the Cub Scouts first -- and then, a year later, I was in the Boy Scouts and they needed a bugler and I said -- "Oh, man, please, I want that job". So, they got me a Boy Scout bugle and I found that I could blow it right away. No problems because I had been blowing on that hose, you know. And, so,

I was the bugler in the Boy Scouts for awhile and I got myself a real good lip on it too; I could really play the damn thing - at my own amazement, you know. And, so, when we organized the first band, which was all school kids, and we had a kid named Sid Bryant, who played the piano and Laird Craven on the Trombone and Gilly Hallet on the alto and we had a violin player - I can't remember his name and, uh, a guy named Paul Derk on the drums and it was, you know, we were all kids -- really kids and yet, it was…
But, you still seem to play the banjo at that point--
